outcome: Reproductive outcomes (pregnancy rates, natural conception rates)
cohort: The study included 93 patients with adenomyosis and infertility treated with either high-intensity focused ultrasound (HIFU) or laparoscopic excision (LE) between January 2012 and January 2017.
finding: HIFU treatment showed significantly higher pregnancy rates and natural conception rates and a shorter hospital stay compared to laparoscopic excision for patients with adenomyosis and infertility.
